name: TableExpandRow

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Space separated list of one or more ID values referencing the TableExpandedRow(s) being controlled by the TableExpandRow / 'aria-controls'?: string; /** removed in the next major release of Carbon. Use the `aria-label` prop instead.

props.name: expandHeader
props.description: Specify the string read by a voice reader when the expand trigger is focused / 'aria-label': string; /** The id of the matching th node in the table head. Addresses a11y concerns outlined here: https://www.ibm.com/able/guidelines/ci162/info_and_relationships.html and https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG20-TECHS/H43

props.name: expandIconDescription
props.description: The description of the chevron right icon, to be put in its SVG `<title>` element.

props.name: isExpanded
props.description: Specify whether this row is expanded or not. This helps coordinate data attributes so that `TableExpandRow` and `TableExpandedRow` work together

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TableExpandRow rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
